scientific_integrity: Established 2003/2004 nonequivariant classification expressly attributed; proof of the equivariant refinement uses a stabilizer-equivariant sink-map fiber contraction and a published equivariant Quillen criterion. Finite checker is a consistency test, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Equivariant homotopy equivalence, not a PL homeomorphism.
Quotient spaces are modeled by representation-sphere orbit spaces, not universally decomposed into standard cell wedges.
Earliest publicly documented dissertation defense is October 21, 2003; any earlier thesis distribution date has not been established.
The 1999 Björner–Welker article was accessible in abstract/secondary theorem citation but not full text; priority risk remains.
title: Natural equivariant sphere models for acyclic directed-subgraph complexes
